subject: Kickoff: logit adjustment for long-tail classifiers
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the long-tail workstream. Nearly every classifier customers train on the platform has a skewed label distribution, and rare-class accuracy is the number-one complaint in the last two feedback rounds. Our logit-adjustment release (ICLR'21) is about the cheapest possible fix — adjust the logits for label frequency, either at training or post-hoc — with strong published gains.

Plan:
- Mar 20: reproduce the release results on the CIFAR-10/100 long-tail datasets (EXP-100 profile .tfrecords, baseline vs adjusted).
- Apr 24: the adjustment available as a flag in the platform trainer.
- May 29: pilot with one partner team on their real long-tail workload, then a rollout decision.

Jelena owns staffing. Carmen leads the reproduction; Farah leads the trainer integration.

Dmitri
